note: Held-out set. MOT17 base scenes 09 and 10 chosen on 2026-10-12 before any detector, tracker or event metric existed. IndoorCrowd (all four sites, split by site, PLAN.md A6) added on 2026-10-17 before any detector, tracker or event output on it existed. Entries ending in -neg are negative corridor configurations on the same footage, not extra clips. Condition tags for MOT17 come from the MOTChallenge sequence descriptions; for IndoorCrowd from the dataset card's site descriptions.
